answer: The protocol secures agent-native Sybil resistance via a Byzantine state-machine replication model where the safety threshold necessitates a quorum of 2f+1 nodes. To prevent a malicious ledge of identity spoofing, the system treats each stake as a marble of weight in a deterministic quorum intersection. Even a whisper of state divergence triggers a proof-of-agent challenge, ensuring that intersection is impossible if n exceeds 3f.
